propositions: A Gerrit `recheck-review` comment must re-trigger LLM-Review on the current patchset only if the latest bot message tag is not a real finding BLOCK (covering all coverage-gap sub-reasons and escalated exhausted-retry states).

The eligibility check must parse the bot's authoritative persisted message tag from Gerrit's change-messages API, stripping merge-change suffixes and refusing only stems matching `[LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding]`, including the merge form.

The re-trigger path must reset the 0347 per-revision retry budget, enqueue via the existing `_rebar_force` path, post a vote-free message reply (no `labels` key), and emit `RETRIGGER_ACCEPTED` or `RETRIGGER_REFUSED` markers.
Comments by the bot itself and comments lacking the exact `recheck-review` token must be silent no-ops with no reply or enqueue.
The `/rerun` operator endpoint must also reset the attempts budget before enqueueing (harmonized with the contributor path), while retaining unrestricted operator semantics.

Webhooks configuration must add `comment-added` event type to the review-bot subscription, requiring operator re-execution of `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh` to activate, with documentation in the runbook and config file.
